highlights.title: Name an agent file as you add it
highlights.line: When Kosmos finds an agent file with no name in it, you can type a name on its row and add it in one go.

highlights.title: Token Usage for every provider
highlights.line: Settings > Token Usage now counts Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok and Antigravity agents beside Claude, per day, model and agent.

highlights.title: Org charts read with any key
highlights.line: Uploading an org chart picture or PDF now works with a key-connected OpenAI, Gemini or Grok account, as well as Claude.

highlights.title: Key accounts get a name
highlights.line: On a Gemini or Grok agent's page, an account connected with an API key now shows as "API key ending" and its last characters.

highlights.title: A refused Restore says why
highlights.line: On the Removed list, a Restore that Kosmos refuses now reads Not restored and shows the reason.
